title: Court-Cost Reserve at Closing Settlement for Clients with Legal Forwarding — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
A reserve covers court costs Ridgeline has advanced on the client's legal matters when fees owed on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements are settled at closing. It is read from the client's legal forwarding agreement under the Legal Forwarding Agreements that names this contingency agreement: that agreement's status and its unreimbursed cost advance balance.

**The reserve.** It is the whole unreimbursed cost advance of the client's legal forwarding agreement that names this contingency agreement where that legal agreement is active and the advance is above zero, half of that advance (0.5 of it) where the legal agreement is suspended and the advance is above zero, and nothing otherwise.

**Where it acts.** The reserve is deducted from the trust balance held in arriving at the available trust balance, which is never less than zero.

## Desk card

| Legal forwarding agreement naming this contingency agreement | Unreimbursed cost advance | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| active | above zero | the whole advance |
| suspended | above zero | half of the advance |
| active or suspended | zero | nothing |
| any other status | any | nothing |
| none held | — | nothing |

## Hypothetical figures

- Active legal forwarding agreement, unreimbursed cost advance 1275.00 USD: reserve 1275.00 USD.
- The same advance with the legal forwarding agreement suspended: reserve 637.50 USD.
- Legal forwarding agreement closed with an advance of 400.00 USD still shown: nothing.
- Trust balance held 900.00 USD, reserve 1275.00 USD, nothing else held back: available trust balance zero.
